content:
ATIC – the Cement Industry Technical Association, together with PTPC – the Portuguese Construction Technology Platform, is developing the Decarbonisation Roadmap for the construction industry and associated industrial activities.

It is in this context that the project’s Opening Conference will be held on 26 November in Porto, where its objectives, areas of coverage and initial diagnostic results will be presented.

The ambition of C2Ø – Construction to Zero is to be a strategic project for Portugal to achieve the targets set for 2050, using synergies within the construction sector and with other industries, integrating technological innovation in processes and contributing to the reduction of GHG emissions. To this end, it aims to draw up evolution scenarios, identify technological solutions and innovative processes that will contribute to its ecological and digital transition, and also provide cross-cutting training in order to implement decarbonisation solutions.

Participation is free, but registration is required here.

This Roadmap is the result of a joint application by ATIC and PTPC to the Support Measure for the Development of Industry Decarbonisation and Company Capacity Building Roadmaps, and is co-financed by the European Union – NextGenerationEU, under the PRR – Recovery and Resilience Plan.

BUILT CoLAB provides specialised technical assistance services, such as research and consultancy relevant to the development of the Roadmap, as well as communication and dissemination of its actions.
